summaries.html:
Streamlining American Manufacturing Strategy Act

This bill requires the strategic plan for the Manufacturing USA program to be updated every four years.

Manufacturing USA is a network of public-private manufacturing innovation institutes. Current law requires the strategic plan for Manufacturing USA to be updated every three years. The bill aligns the timeline for updates to the Manufacturing USA strategic plan with the timeline for updates to the National Strategy for Advanced Manufacturing, such that both documents must be updated at four-year intervals.
